svg.text: ELECTRICAL ROOM 109: MDP, T-1, LP-1, HP-1; SERVICE 400A 480Y/277V FROM PAD-MOUNT XFMR (UTILITY)
1. SERVICE: 400A, 480Y/277V, 3PH, 4W; UTILITY PAD-MOUNT TRANSFORMER AND PRIMARY BY ONCOR (NIC).
2. RECEPTACLES: 48 DUPLEX 20A; DATA OUTLETS: 24 (RACEWAY AND BOXES ONLY; CABLING BY OWNER).
3. BRANCH CIRCUITS 3/4" EMT WITH THHN; FEEDERS PER ONE-LINE; APPROX. 3,400 LF CONDUIT.
4. LIGHTING CONTROLS: OCCUPANCY SENSORS IN ALL OFFICES; PHOTOCELL/TIMECLOCK FOR EXTERIOR.
5. FIRE ALARM: ADDRESSABLE, MONITORED; SPRINKLER FLOW/TAMPER SUPERVISION.
